description: Real Linux 7.2.4 running natively on the ESP32-S3's Xtensa cores (not emulated), with working WiFi and the chip's hardware RSA accelerator exposed to the Linux Crypto API and fork(). One flashable image; 16MB flash / 8MB PSRAM; NOMMU; STA-only.
